_port_note: tick: request. B2BSalesSystem._tick_clause names it the tick a server-clause notice enters its last week (Erdem, 2026-11-12, N03: the notice mail's button becomes a decision at the workday's end). The account leaves at the notice's end whatever the card says; only the move keeps it. Moving to Enterprise meets every account's clause (InfraSystem.set_provider → meet_clauses) and has no way back, which the chip's bill says.
